gatePriorTotals._note: Calibration round 50, kept unchanged in round 51. In a period whose stations take simulated membership, the fit first runs as the baseline does (static membership, no ceilings); every node direction (every origin or destination of a car flow, gates and non-gate nodes) that no gate station in the fit counts is then held, by a one-sided soft constraint of the given weight, to at most its car total in that static fit times (1 + tolerancePct / 100), and a hard projection guarantees it on the final flows (tools/lib/demand-fit.ts gatePriorStations, projectToCeilings). Simulated membership may move trips among pairs but may not add a trip end at any node, so through demand cannot become local demand. A regularizer toward the static fit: tolerancePct 0 and weight 10 (five times the ramp weight) are ASSUMPTIONS, not sourced. No count value sets a ceiling. Without scope (or scope gates) only gate nodes are capped, as in round 49. Periods without simulated membership (the loop's pass 0, midday) have no ceilings and no second fit.

simulatedMembership._note: Calibration round 48, extended in round 51. Every fitted station the report binary exports (link stations with a detector list or counted at the block, movement and route stations) takes its membership from simulated trips: each pair's share of trips at the station over seed runs of the demand of the same view, pooled with equal weight over the loop's passes (tools/membership-loop.ts), with the static share as a prior worth priorTrips trips (ASSUMPTION). Stations without an export (gate totals) and periods without runs (midday) keep static membership. The training view reads trainingFile, built only from runs of the cross-validation demand and naming no withheld station. The files are under target/ and are not committed. Round 51 sub-switches, both absent in rounds 48 to 50: throughTargets takes the through-car targets (select-link blocks marked fitThrough) and shares takes the select-link share constraints from the runs' block export (calibrate --select-od, blocks): the pairs of every trip that used a link of the block, pooled like the stations. A share's denominator membership of a pair is its simulated share of trips on the block with the static fraction as a prior worth priorTrips trips (ASSUMPTION); its numerator is the same for pairs whose origin (from) or destination (to) is a freeway node and 0 for the rest. A block without a simulated trip keeps static routes and is listed. Ramp via-street shares keep static routes: nothing exports them per pair. While this entry is present it replaces the hand-picked measuredStations list and the measured file.
